items.source: Uses of CodecException in org.springframework.core.codec
items.translation: CodecException 在 org.springframework.core.codec 中的用法

items.source: Encoder and Decoder abstractions to convert between a reactive stream of bytes and Java objects.
items.translation: Encoder 和 Decoder 抽象用于在字节反应式流与 Java 对象之间进行转换。

items.source:
Indicates an issue with decoding the input stream with a focus on content
related issues such as a parse failure.
items.translation: 指示输入流解码存在问题，重点关注内容相关问题，例如解析失败。

items.source:
Indicates an issue with encoding the input Object stream with a focus on
not being able to encode Objects.
items.translation: 指示在编码输入对象流时出现问题，重点是无法编码对象。
